items.title: Class Room: area per room below the norm

text:
LETTER OF DEFICIENCY (DRAFT)
File No.: AICTE/RB/SO/2027-28/APP-15
Date: 2026-10-27
Institute: Hillcrest Technical Campus
Permanent Id: 1-4667460
Application: APP-15 (2027-28)

The following deficiencies were found in the application for Extension of Approval:
1. Class Room: area per room below the norm (built-up area statement)
   3 Class Room room(s), 144 sq m in total = 48.0 sq m per room; the norm is at least 66 sq m per room (Engineering and Technology).
   Handbook: "3.2.1 Instructional Area, A"
   To submit: Submit a revised built-up area statement showing the required area, or the building plan approved for it.

Draft prepared by Pramaan (advisory). To be reviewed and signed by the competent officer.
